name: PETAPETA｜0.1.2
desc:
DO NOT touch on supernatural being. Experience an immersive Japanese-style horror game.

Update on Oct 16
・The Halloween Event has begun!
The boundary between our world and the spirit world is fading, and Yokai have begun to appear throughout PETAPETA!
Collect Higanbana, mysterious red flowers connected to the spirit world, and unlock limited Yokai Masks (in-game skins).
Explore. Collect. Unlock. Join the Hyakki Yako (Night Parade of a Hundred Yokai)!

-Recommendation/Warning
Max graphics setting recommended
Headphone recommended
The game contains flashing lights and loud noises.
